name: Fairbnb.coop
sdg_alignment: SDG 8 – Decent Work and Economic Growth
dependency_risks: Coordinated spam attacks targeting platform infrastructure
Fraudulent booking requests from suspicious accounts
academic_citations: Scholz, T., & Schneider, N. (2016). Ours to Hack and to Own: The Rise of Platform Cooperativism, a New Vision for the Future of Work and a Fairer Internet
published_performance_metrics: Limited public disclosure; platform reports community impact through annual reports
documented_limitations: Platform currently offline due to security maintenance
failure_modes: Security infrastructure compromised by coordinated attack
Fraudulent account creation and booking requests
curation_criteria: Community-driven moderation; cooperative member voting on platform policies
contributor_governance: Democratic governance through cooperative membership; decisions made by member assemblies
disparity_tracking: Tracks equitable distribution of tourism revenue to local communities; monitors host diversity
government_partnerships: City of Bologna (Italy) - local tourism partnership
ai_involvement: Minimal; basic recommendation algorithms for host-guest matching

scraped.scraped_description: A vacation rental platform which gives back 50% of its revenues to support local community projects of your choice.

political_relevance_summary: Fairbnb.coop addresses civic data access and transparency. Community powered tourism platform.

movement_building_utility.notes: Provides technical infrastructure that other civic tools or services build upon.

generalizability_notes: Highly generalizable; already deployed across multiple countries. Open-source codebase facilitates replication.
